summary: Comprehensive testing of BidBlitz V2 Export UI feature completed. All 21 backend export API tests passed. All frontend export UI flows tested and working: WalletPage, MerchantPage, and AdminPage export sections with CSV downloads and filter functionality. i18n translations working correctly in German.

design_issues.issue: Console warning about chart width/height being -1. Non-blocking, chart still renders.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Export UI feature is fully implemented and working. All three pages (WalletPage, MerchantPage, AdminPage) have ExportSection components with proper data-testid attributes. CSV downloads work via fetch+blob+createObjectURL pattern. Backend returns StreamingResponse with text/csv media type. Admin exports correctly require admin role (403 for regular users). i18n translations are complete for German (DE) and English (EN).

export_feature_summary.filter_support: Date range filters (date_from, date_to) available on all export sections
